name: Magnitude Shift (Shifting)
body:
Prerequisite: 2 or more Shifting feats.
Benefit: You shrink 1 size category, as per reduce person, except that it affects you regardless of your creature type and does not affect your ability scores. This shift lasts for 10 minutes. However, if you reduce the shift duration to 1 minute, you may instead grow 1 size category, as per enlarge person, except that it affects you regardless of your creature type and does not affect your ability scores. Both size changes do not stack with other size changing effects.
Special: At 4 Shifting feats, you may shrink 2 size categories.This shift lasts for 1 hour and does not affect your ability scores.
At 5 Shifting feats, you may grow 2 size categories. This shift lasts for 2 rounds and does not affect your ability scores.
